highlights: OD1 cut the 38" conductor pipe and installed the protection structure, and was released to new well BOUM-0001. The rig is on standby and waits for BOUM-0001 location clearance.
Overstay crew fell from 13 to 10. HLB cleared both of its overstay crew. COSL still holds 10 and needs follow up.
OD1 personnel onboard fell from 82 to 75. 53 of the 75 hold a seaman or business visa.
OPH stayed off-hired for a second week, and demobilisation continued. CA1 discharged 21 lifts at OPH across Tue 01 and Wed 02 Sep.
Vessel trips held at 9, but the mix changed. CA1 fell from 4 trips to 2. CA3 and CA5 each ran 1 trip after most of the week on station. Charlie-3 again ran all 5 crew change circuits.
Truck moves also held at 41 on a consistent count, against the 46 the 26-08 report published. Per day the rate fell from 6.8 to 5.1, because this period runs 8 days against the previous 6.
Ground transport peaked on Mon 31 Aug with 8 dispatches, of which six trucks carried empty mud skips to HETCO Mina Abdallah Yard.
Cut casing joints of 18-5/8", 13-5/8", 10-3/4" and 7-5/8" went to the KOC scrap yard on Sun 30 Aug. The SWT burner boom sections A, B and C moved to TSS-WT Hall Mina Abdallah on Wed 02 Sep.
Fluids handled fell by about half, 742 m³ against 1,452 m³, and no slops movement is recorded. The port ran day shift only on all eight days.
dataNotes: Reporting window is 8 days (26 Aug to 02 Sep). The previous report covered 6 days (20 to 25 Aug). Absolute counts are therefore not like for like, so the comparison table carries a per day row.
